notes:
Tier-1 HTTP fetch only (curl); no Playwright/Chrome needed. westelm.in is a Fynd-Commerce storefront (unrelated to West Elm US's own platform) with a documented agent-friendly surface: robots.txt (no Claude-specific disallow; Allow for Googlebot; Sitemap link) -> agents.md (confirms Fynd Commerce, gives GET /products/, /collection/{slug} read-only endpoints) -> sitemap.xml -> sitemap/collections.sitemap.xml (~640 collection URLs, the real taxonomy index) and category_l1/l2/l3 sitemaps (only 3-4 stub test entries each, not useful). Downloaded collections.sitemap.xml and grepped for christmas/diwali/halloween/holi/valentine/thanksgiving/new-year/rakhi/raksha/eid/mother/father/festive/holiday/easter/navratri/deepavali keywords. Also pulled the live site's Header navigation JSON (embedded in every page's SSR payload) to see which collections are actually wired into the current menu vs. sitemap-only orphans, and pulled item_total (true cursor-paginated product count) plus a sample of real product names/descriptions for every seasonal-looking collection. Total site catalog = 1521 products (from /products/ with no filter), used as the denominator for the 20-30% red-flag check.

Candidates found and verified by content sampling:
- Genuine Christmas: /collection/pillows-and-decor-room-decor-christmas-dcor (71 items: glass ornaments, garlands, votive holders, faux fur throws - clearly Christmas décor) and /collection/holidays-christmas-decor (60 items: shimmering glass trees, ball ornaments, candy-cane ornaments, wood/brass deer objects - clearly Christmas). Both are real, separately-numbered PLPs (different item counts, different nav parents: one under Pillows&Decor>Room Decor, one under the Holidays branch) so both are kept as separate rows despite product overlap, per the 'seasonal deliberately overlaps other categories' rule. In the live nav JSON both entries currently carry active:false (nav toggle off, plausibly because it's September and the Nov/Dec Christmas campaign hasn't been switched on yet) but the pages themselves are live, populated, and indexed in sitemap.xml, so they qualify as genuine site taxonomy.
- /collection/holidays (71 items) is the parent 'Holidays' menu node (also active:false in nav); its displayed product list is identical to pillows-and-decor-room-decor-christmas-dcor's list, i.e. it is currently just surfacing the Christmas Decor set. Kept as an is_group parent row per the no-double-count rule; its qty is not summed against the Christmas Decor rows.
- /collection/holidays-pillows--throws (4 items: Silk Scandi Diamond Pillow Cover, Faux Fur Plush Throw, Faux Fur Chinchilla Throw, 'Nicole Cicak Ice Skating' Pillow Cover) is genuinely winter/holiday-themed by name, small and curated. IMPORTANT: this is a sitemap-only orphan -- the live 'Holidays > Pillows & Throws' nav slot actually points to a different, similarly-named slug (holiday-pillows-and-throws, no double dash) which resolved to 216 generic products (see exclusions below). Kept the small genuine orphan, excluded the large generic live-nav one; flagged accordingly.
- /collection/holidays-dinnerware (6 items: napkin sets, glass decanters, barware, napkin ring sets) is a small curated set under the live Holidays nav branch (og:title 'West Elm Holiday Dinnerware'). Evidence is mixed: one item's own product description says 'seasonally inspired embroidered juniper border' (juniper = winter/Christmas motif) but most of the 6 have fully generic descriptions with no holiday cue. Included with a caution flag given the site's demonstrated pattern of relabeling generic sets as holiday collections, but this one is small (0.4% of catalog) rather than a bulk catalog dump.
- /collection/diwali-gift-hampers (3 items: Kora Pillar Candle Gift Hamper, Starlight Stemware Gift Hamper, Streamline Bar Collection Gift Hamper) is a small, explicitly Diwali-labeled curated hamper set (og:title 'West Elm Diwali Gift hampers'). It is a sitemap-only orphan (not reachable from current live nav). Included as a genuine small curated PLP but flagged for the orphan status and thin overall Diwali footprint on the site (internal search for 'diwali' returns only 1 matching product).

Excluded after sampling (the exact 'large-fraction generic catalog mislabeled as a holiday' trap called out in task instructions):
- /collection/mothers-day (732 items, 48% of the 1521-item catalog; page's own <title>/og:title is the generic homepage title 'West Elm - Buy Modern Furniture Online in India', not a Mother's Day title; sampled products are plain glass hurricanes, leather catchalls, wood lanterns, bath mats, ceramic objects - zero occasion-specific framing). Nav entry is also active:false. Its children /collection/thoughtful-picks (268) and /collection/gifts-theyll-love (368) were also sampled and are equally generic (vases, pillow covers, quilts, blankets) - excluded as inherited from a disproven parent.
- /collection/fathers-day (324 items, 21% of catalog; sampled products are a swivel chair, an arm chair, a table lamp, leather catchalls, a trinket tray - plain furniture/decor with no Father's Day framing). Nav entry active:false.
- /collection/diwali-gifts (666 items, 44% of catalog; live nav actually labels this slot 'Gifts & Hampers', not Diwali, sitting alongside Wedding Gifts and House Warming Gifts under 'Gifts By Occasion'; sampled products are generic pillow covers, a comforter set, leather catchalls - no diyas/torans/rangoli/festive-light Diwali cues at all). Internal site search for 'diwali' returns only 1 product total, corroborating that this 666-item bucket is not a genuine Diwali catalog.
- /collection/festive-shop (807 items, 53% of catalog; sampled products are glass hurricanes, porcelain dinner plates/bowls, stoneware, glassware sets - generic dinnerware/entertaining items with no festive-specific styling).
- /collection/holiday-pillows-and-throws (216 items, 14% of catalog; this IS the slug the live Holidays>Pillows&Throws nav entry points to; sampled products - Mixed Slub Texture Pillow Cover, Solid Faux Mohair Pillow Cover, TENCEL Plush Comforter & Shams, Deco Velvet set, Pierce & Ward Twill Stripe - are the exact same generic pillow/throw items seen padding out diwali-gifts and mothers-day, no holiday motifs).
- /collection/gifts-by-occasion (652 items) is a mixed-occasion grouping page (children: Diwali-slugged 'Gifts & Hampers', Wedding Gifts, House Warming Gifts) - not itself tied to one holiday, so excluded entirely rather than treated as a seasonal grouping row.

Explicitly checked and confirmed absent anywhere in the sitemap or live nav (keyword search across all ~640 collection URLs and the full Header nav JSON): Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Holi (all 'holi' hits were substrings of 'holiday'/'holidays'), Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi, Eid, Navratri. No blog/lookbook/gift-guide page was substituted for a real PLP; all included rows are true collection PLPs with their own SSR-rendered cursor-paginated product listings.
